_doc: World simulation data. secrets: what you find when you search a secret spot (maps list them under 'secrets'). weather: odds per term and effects. events: things that happen without you (js/systems/world.js has a handler per 'do'); every ~30 game minutes one may fire. paths: the routes to success, their titles and endings.

hiddenMoney.text: Under the locker, somebody hide ₦300 inside sock. Finders keepers? 👀

confiscationBox.text: The confiscation box! Phones, novels, a heater, one perfume… If yours dey here, you fit carry am back. 😳

seniorDiary.text: A diary under the bunk: 'Day 41: Junior {junior} still no bring my water.' You learn which seniors dey hate who.
seniorDiary.rumour: One senior's diary don leak — the gist hot 📔

loveLetters.text: A bundle of love letters tied with rubber band. The names inside… omo. This gist fit scatter the school.
loveLetters.rumour: Love letters don leak from behind the girls' hostel 💌

oldNotes.text: Inside the desk: somebody's old lesson notes, neat like typewriter. 📓

graffitiNote.text: Scratched inside the desk: 'The exam cabinet key dey under the staff room flower pot.' Hmm. 🤔

markbookScribble.text: Teacher's mark book open small: next test na on the topic they've been hammering. You memorise am. (+1 hint next test)

stinkBomb.text: Behind the bottles: a vial wey dem label 'H₂S — DO NOT OPEN'. 💨

skeletonKey.text: An old key on a string, labelled 'STORE'. Na here dem dey keep the cutlasses. 🔑

meatTicket.text: Under the prefects' tray: a list of who dey get extra meat. Your name no dey there. 😑
meatTicket.rumour: Dining prefects dey chop extra meat every day — list don leak 🍗

keeperLedger.text: Mama Tuck-shop's credit book. Half the SS3 class owe her money. 📒
keeperLedger.rumour: SS3 people owe Mama Tuck-shop ₦50,000 combined 😂

pastQuestions.text: Behind the dusty encyclopaedia: a booklet of PAST QUESTIONS. Gold! 📑

loveNote.text: Inside 'Things Fall Apart': a note — 'Meet me by the mango tree after prep.' Who wrote am?? 👀

sickChit.text: A pad of blank sick bay chits — one don already sign. You 'borrow' one. 🧾

exeatForm.text: A blank exeat form with the VP's signature already on it. Dangerous treasure. 📝

yourFile.text: Your own file. 'Character: {character}. Discipline: {points} points.' Na so dem see you. 📁

oldHymnal.text: Inside an old hymn book: ₦200 offering wey nobody collect. Hmm. 🪙

misbaha.text: Beautiful prayer beads left on the mihrab. You hold am small and feel peace. 📿

testAnswers.text: Marking guide for this week's test! You see three answers before your heart start to beat. (+1 hint next test)

teacherGist.text: Teachers' notice: 'Exam questions are in the red cabinet. Keep it LOCKED.' Somebody no lock am. 👀

bushStash.text: Something wrapped in nylon inside the bush… a PHONE! 📱

jollofBackdoor.text: Chalk on the wall behind the dining hall: 'JOLLOF ₦300 — 8:30PM'. 🍛

events.text: 🥊 Fight don burst for {place}! {a} and {b} dey exchange blows!
📢 {teacher} no come school today — free period for {subject}!
🌧️ Rain don start! Everybody run enter building.
🚨 House master dey raid the hostel for contraband!
🐍 SNAKE!!! Somebody see snake for the hostel!
🧐 SURPRISE INSPECTION! The VP is checking uniforms, nails and hair.

scholar.label: Top of the Class
scholar.ending: You graduate as the school's academic star — your name dey the honours board forever.

sports.label: Sports Star
sports.ending: Inter-house medals, the cheering, the trophies — the field remember your name.

leader.label: Prefect & Leader
leader.ending: Teachers trust you, juniors follow you. You lead from the front.

hustle.label: Hustler
hustle.ending: Provisions, deliveries, credit — you run the school's economy.

popular.label: Popular Icon
popular.ending: Everybody know your name — from JSS1 to the cooks.

trouble.label: Troublemaker Legend
trouble.ending: Fence jumps, raids, near-expulsions — the stories go outlive you.
